hooks.name: Review current diff in this session
hooks.description: Append an on-demand semantic-review prompt to the current profile.

action.prompt: Review the current diff using the loaded steering rules. Verify every finding, cite exact evidence, and report CLEAN when no finding survives verification. This action runs in the current profile; do not modify files during this review.

hooks.name: Check acceptance-criteria coverage in this session
hooks.description: Append an on-demand AC-to-test gap-check prompt to the current profile.

action.prompt: Map every acceptance criterion in product-context.md to a proving test in tests/acceptance/. Report P0 and P1 gaps; do not perform a general code review or modify files during this check. This action runs in the current profile.
